$comment: Performance budgets and measured baselines (design: docs/PERFORMANCE.md, ADR 0018/0023). CI runs crates/term-core/tests/perf.rs and miaotty-app perf_tests in release; each metric fails if it exceeds its absolute budget OR regresses more than regression_pct vs the recorded baseline.

build_rows_frame_ms.note: roadmap frame-time budget (p99 < 4 ms); covers the damage rebuild path

cold_start_ms.note: not a CI gate; measured manually

new_pane_ms.note: not a CI gate; measured manually

ipc_idle_cost.note: by design: MTP is event-driven, coalesced to <=1 repaint/frame

agent_burst_coalesce.note: by design: state changes set pane.dirty; one repaint per frame
